## What changed / Что изменено

Describe the problem, the change and a related issue if one exists.
Опишите задачу и решение, приложите ссылку на issue, если он есть.

## Verification / Проверка

Explain what was actually checked, on which OS/hardware/model, and what remains unverified.
Укажите выполненную проверку, ОС/железо/модель и известные ограничения.

## User impact / Для пользователя

- Are setup instructions or translations affected?
- Are there changes to chats, models, project files or update compatibility?
- Include a screenshot for a visible interface change.

Keep credentials, model weights, private chats and generated installers out of the PR.
